data_fields.name: phaseCount
data_fields.donor_constant: count of [time] children; no cap in code

data_fields.name: eventsPerTurn
data_fields.donor_constant: turn_N and new_turn fire once per turn (latch)

best_idea: A zone's day/night and event schedule is a list of data phases indexed by modulo of elapsed server time, with a once-per-tick latch so an event fires once no matter how many players cause the tick.
decision_why: Keep the modulo phase clock and once-per-tick latch, key them to server seconds and store phases as zone data; keep light out of combat until a ruling exists, since the donor feeds light into combat bonus.
acceptance: A server test with a 3-phase zone schedule asserts the phase at tick T equals phases[(start + elapsed) mod 3] across two full cycles, and a zone event fires once when two players trigger the same tick.
